findings.title: Exact-C controlling-input lock omits named directive families
evidence: The exact-C evidence-only child fbeabe binds candidate commit/tree but INPUTS.lock lines 19-60 contain only eight inputs: campaign, handoff, STATE, MISSION, ARCHITECTURE, DESIGN, DIRECTOR, and AGENTS.
I00, IP_RUNTIME, IP_CONTROL, IP_OPS, IP_PROOF, POST_I00, IP_ASSURANCE, Frontier, deployment, and superseded-directive hashes are absent.
A byte-sound protected verifier bundle cannot replace an immutable controlling-input lock because it is explicitly a packaged snapshot and the physical owner inputs are absent.

findings.title: Frontier has no candidate-bound directive coverage row
evidence: The exact-C 124-row directive matrix contains zero Frontier rows.
Candidate C contains zero frontier/** paths and root STATE classifies Frontier as REFERENCE_ONLY.

The clean census classifies 20 Frontier/scout worktrees ABANDONED_SAFE, but no implementation+test+evidence row or explicit candidate-bound family disposition row carries that ruling into directive coverage.

findings.title: MISSION and ARCHITECTURE rows contain false paths and omit permanent requirements
evidence: Exact-C matrix rows MIS-002, MIS-004, MIS-007, MIS-008, ARC-001, ARC-002, ARC-007, and ARC-010 cite nonexistent or wrong test/owner paths such as server/test/**/basis*, web/src/features/productControlRoom/**/*.test*, test/i00/security/**, server/src/foundation/ledger, and test/i00/authority/**.

Actual proving paths include server/test/engine-basis.mjs, server/test/engine-volume.mjs, web/test/productControlRoom/**, server/test/i00Acceptance/security-boundary.test.mjs, test/i00/scope-security.mjs, server/src/ledger.ts, and server/test/i00Acceptance/authority-protocol.test.mjs.

No explicit rows cover the MISSION first-adapter anti-expansion law, full new-lens contract, bounded agent authorities, structurally-real runtime/UI verification, must-never-become constraints, or official-document reverification; ARCHITECTURE cross-engine projection, exact active-position attribution, and signed-action absence also lack exact rows.
